item.title: Organise Your Romantasy TBR in Notion — Reading Journal Template
item.description: Your next fictional obsession has a place. Track your TBR, trope bait, spice forecasts and reading status in The Feral Grimoire Notion reading journal. Actual template preview with sample entries shown. Duplicate into your own workspace; works on the free Notion plan. Digital template, £7.99.
